row: Community-STARs is an outpatient pediatric therapy clinic for children ages 0-21 years old. We believe a child’s work is play and we are passionate about our work!  At C-STARs, we aim high, we aim big, we shoot for the stars, and we get there through small, incremental, doable steps.  We are located in Culpeper, Virginia - also serving Madison, Greene, Orange, Charlottesville, Rappahannock, and Fauquier. Our hope is to use this platform to provide resources for our community and the families that we provide services for.
